title: Exact-one promise problem
statement: For an encoded maximization problem, the yes-instances are the well-formed inputs whose stated optimum is exactly $1$, and the no-instances are the well-formed inputs whose stated optimum is less than $1$. Inputs outside these two sets are not assigned either promise.
